notes: All 120 speedup values in the record match Tables 1-3. Only speedup ratios are tabulated; absolute per-epoch times appear only in log-scale Figs. 3-8 (not extractable as text). No accuracies reported. Clause scope is ambiguous: Sec. 3 Remarks call 20000 'the total number of clauses' for MNIST, but the quoted inclusion-list sizes (about 740 clauses per literal at clause length 58 over 1568 literals; 232 per literal for IMDb) only add up if 20000 clauses are per class, so clauses_scope is not_reported. The 8-bit TA memory in the memory-footprint paragraph is an assumption for a calculation, not the experimental setting, so state_bits is not_reported. Train/test splits, number of runs, epochs, T, s, hardware and implementation are not stated. Train speedups are per training epoch; test speedups per inference pass.
